sources.title: ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-PT model card
sources.evidence: Identifies this as the post-trained text MoE, nominally 21B total/3B activated, with 131072-token context and Apache-2.0 weights. PT means PyTorch; Base-PT is a separate pretrained variant.

sources.title: ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-PT configuration
sources.evidence: Ernie4_5_MoeForCausalLM; 28 layers, hidden size 2560, 27 MoE layers, 64 routed experts with six selected, two shared experts, tied embeddings, one MTP layer, and 131072 positions.

sources.title: Complete checkpoint tensor index and nine indexed safetensors shards
sources.evidence: Read the index and byte-range JSON headers of all nine shards, without downloading their tensor payloads. 5504 tensors contain 21948655808 elements: BF16 weights 21944230400 plus F32 routers/biases 4425408. MTP tensors total 123217920. No quantization scales or packed weights occur. Parent independently fetched all nine headers pinned at revision 87db95487941cb39592ee0abca3b9155a6d19c5c and confirmed exact tensor inventory and count.

sources.title: Checkpoint tensor metadata
sources.evidence: Independent safetensors metadata agrees with the header sum: total 21948655808, BF16 21944230400 and F32 4425408. Repository creation on June 28 is not evidence of public release.

sources.title: MoECorrectionBiasAdjustCallback training implementation
sources.evidence: Auxiliary-loss-free balancing updates e_score_correction_bias after optimizer steps from expert-usage imbalance under no_grad. Therefore the checkpoint's 1728 correction-bias values are trained routing state, not storage metadata, and remain included in the complete count.

sources.title: ERNIE 4.5 Technical Report, Table 1
sources.evidence: Downloaded and extracted the primary PDF after web rendering hit a size limit. Table 1 labels the exact ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B as post-trained, non-multimodal, MoE and non-thinking, separately from Base and vision variants.

sources.title: Announcing the Open Source Release of the ERNIE 4.5 Model Family
sources.evidence: June 30, 2025 open-weight announcement includes the post-trained 21B-A3B and states Apache-2.0 availability, including PyTorch-compatible weights.

sources.title: Qianfan model release history
sources.evidence: The 2025 June table records ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B as newly available through text-generation API V2 on June 29, with 21B total and 3B activated parameters. The exact row was verified in live HTML as well as indexed text; this predates the June 30 weight announcement.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Template formats system, user and assistant messages only; it contains no tools argument, tool role or tool-call serialization. Absence alone does not establish universal inability to emit function calls.

sources.title: FastDeploy tool calling documentation
sources.evidence: Support table identifies ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-Thinking, but a generic example uses a local path omitting Thinking while showing reasoning output. This conflicting naming is insufficient to verify tools for the original PT checkpoint.

sources.title: Distinct ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-Thinking model card
sources.evidence: Later Thinking variant explicitly advertises tool use and function calling, with reasoning/tool parser flags. Those capabilities are not transferred to the original non-thinking variant.

name.note: Display-name normalization of ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B; PT denotes the PyTorch format, not a pretraining stage.

developer.note: Baidu publishes the model and its technical report.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit exact-model public availability located: Baidu Qianfan API launch June 29. The open-weight announcement is June 30. June 28 repository creation does not prove public availability.

open_weights.note: Baidu distributes all nine checkpoint shards publicly.

license.note: Exact model card and release announcement declare Apache License 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Complete published checkpoint count: 21948655808 learned tensor elements, including 123217920 MTP parameters and 1728 training-adjusted router biases. All nine shard headers inspected; no quantization/storage buffers found. Baidu's 21B is nominal, not the full-precision tensor count.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-reported activated parameters per token. This is not an exact computed active count and does not imply every MTP weight participates in ordinary decoding.

architecture.note: Transformer text decoder with attention and sparse MoE feed-forward blocks; exact config selects six of 64 routed experts plus two shared experts in 27 layers.

context_window.note: Exact model card context and max_position_embeddings agree on 131072 tokens.

modalities.note: Text input/output. Joint multimodal family pretraining does not make this extracted text checkpoint multimodal.

reasoning.note: Table 1 explicitly marks this exact post-trained model non-thinking. This flag describes a dedicated thinking mode, not ordinary reasoning ability.

tool_call.note: Exact original card lacks a tool claim and its template lacks tool formatting. FastDeploy's support table names Thinking but its example omits that suffix. Explicit function-call evidence applies to Thinking. Clear baseline true rather than transfer sibling capability or infer false from omission.

description.value: Open-weight, post-trained ERNIE 4.5 text MoE with about 21.95B checkpoint parameters and a nominal 3B active per token.
description.note: States the exact post-trained text variant and distinguishes complete checkpoint count from nominal active count.

patch.description: Open-weight, post-trained ERNIE 4.5 text MoE with about 21.95B checkpoint parameters and a nominal 3B active per token.
patch.notes: PT means PyTorch; this is the post-trained non-thinking model, distinct from Base and Thinking. Complete checkpoint: 21.948655808B parameters including 0.123217920B MTP and 1728 training-adjusted routing biases; advertised 21B total / 3B active are nominal. Qianfan documents hosted release June 29, 2025; weights were announced June 30. Tool calling for this exact variant remains unverified because first-party examples conflict with the Thinking-only support table.

summary: Assessed all 14 fields individually. Corrects total parameters to the complete 21.948655808B checkpoint, provenance to primary_source, and earliest public release to June 29, 2025 (hosted API; June 30 weights). Confirms non-thinking text MoE, nominal 3B active, 131072 context and Apache-2.0. Clears tool_call=true to null because exact-variant support remains unresolved. PT is PyTorch, not pretrained.
